    Write-Error "Geen token gevonden. Vul eerst $token in."
    exit

Write-Host "Token ingesteld (eerste 20 chars): $($token.Substring(0,20))..."

# ==============================================
# Stap 2 — SQL seedbestand inlezen
# ==============================================
Write-Host ">>> Stap 2: SQL-bestand inlezen..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

$seedPath = "C:\Users\John Koenders\Downloads\promati_seed.sql"

if (-not (Test-Path $seedPath)) {
    Write-Error "SQL-bestand niet gevonden op: $seedPath"
    exit
}

$sqlText = Get-Content $seedPath -Raw
Write-Host "SQL-bestand geladen!"

# ==============================================
# Stap 3 — Statements splitsen
# ==============================================
Write-Host ">>> Stap 3: SQL-statements opsplitsen..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

$stmts = $sqlText -split ";[\r\n]+" | Where-Object { $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 }

Write-Host "Aantal statements gevonden:" $stmts.Count

# ==============================================
# Stap 4 — Statements uitvoeren via /chatdb/sql
# ==============================================
Write-Host ">>> Stap 4: Statements uitvoeren..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

$ok = 0
$err = 0

foreach ($stmt in $stmts) {
    $clean = $stmt.Trim()

    # commentaar overslaan
    if ($clean.StartsWith("--")) { continue }

    $json = @{ sql = $clean } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

    $resp = curl.exe -s -X POST "http://localhost:8000/chatdb/sql" `
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" `
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" `
        --data-binary $json

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and -not ($resp | Select-String "detail")) {
        $ok++
    } else {
        $err++
        Write-Warning "❌ FOUT bij statement:"
        Write-Host $clean
        Write-Host $resp -ForegroundColor Red
    }
}

# ==============================================
# Einde
# ==============================================
Write-Host "====================================="
Write-Host "KLAAR!"
Write-Host "Succesvol: $ok"
Write-Host "Fouten:    $err"
Write-Host "====================================="
